risks.title: Source gate not fully green
risks.reproduction: The independently retained serial and parallel reports each contain source-owned failures.

risks.title: External custody tests blocked
risks.reproduction: Seven registered lanes require external broker, raw-filing, fixed-point or installed-host evidence.

risks.title: GitHub workflow omits most registered tests
risks.reproduction: The baseline workflow does not execute the source-owned development-gate registry as an exact-once partition.

risks.title: No durable installed-host certification evidence
risks.reproduction: The source identity is not_installed and no schema-valid installed-host receipt exists in durable custody.

risks.title: Source release identity drift
risks.reproduction: The root release manifest identifies an older product and can be preferred by source identity resolution.

risks.title: Generated instruction surfaces drift from canonical source
risks.reproduction: Checked-in instruction snapshots omit the canonical carrier-migration block.

risks.title: Alias dictionaries can remain sole material authority
risks.reproduction: A direct alias may be accepted for a material semantic role without an independent contextual evidence channel.

risks.title: Source arithmetic lacks typed precision custody
risks.reproduction: Baseline subtotal inference uses a fixed absolute tolerance and can admit missing-state or cross-dimensional coincidences.

risks.title: Authority ledger is not a complete material-row census
risks.reproduction: Formula-owned, schedule-owned, not-applicable or unresolved material rows can be absent from the sealed ledger.

risks.title: Critical tests are vulnerable to self-confirmation
risks.reproduction: Some workbooks and expected outputs are checked through producer-owned graphs, tolerances or mappings.

risks.title: Full source report lacks exact durable reproduction bindings
risks.reproduction: The tracked summary does not bind the complete exact-once registry, source SHA and protected input hashes.

risks.title: No permanent development tag and durable package asset
risks.reproduction: The frozen baseline predates the later v3.7.0 development release publication.

risks.title: Real-world corpus coverage is narrow
risks.reproduction: The strongest gates depend on synthetic fixtures or absent external corpora rather than a broad real-source cohort.

risks.title: Critical modules remain oversized
risks.reproduction: Several compiler, emitter and controller files retain multiple economic responsibilities and raise change-coupling risk.
